description.zh: 以身份为中心展示"这是谁、有什么、在做什么"的页面：封面与头像建立视觉身份， 下方是姓名、简介与统计数字，再用页签切换动态、作品或文章等内容流。 他人视角配关注/私信按钮，本人视角配编辑入口，页面结构相同而操作不同。
description.en: An identity-centered page answering "who is this, what do they have, what do they do": cover and avatar establish visual identity, name, bio and stats follow, and tabs switch between content streams like posts, works or articles. Visitors see follow/message actions; the owner sees edit entries — same structure, different actions.

use_when.zh: 社区、创作者平台展示用户身份与内容
use_when.en: Communities and creator platforms showing identity and content

use_when.zh: 团队成员/作者等人物介绍页
用户需要查看或管理自己的公开形象
use_when.en: Users view or manage their public presence

avoid_when.zh: 纯功能性的账号信息修改（并入设置页）
avoid_when.en: Pure account data editing — fold into settings

avoid_when.zh: 无内容流、只留联系方式的极简名片（静态区块即可）
avoid_when.en: Minimal contact cards with no content stream

avoid_when.zh: 需要强营销转化的官方品牌页
avoid_when.en: Official brand pages with conversion goals

note.zh: 信息收在一张圆角卡片内，克制通用
note.en: Info contained in one card, restrained and universal

note.zh: 大封面 + 叠放头像，社交平台标准
note.en: Big cover with overlapping avatar, the social standard

note.zh: 只留头像、一句话与链接，名片风
note.en: Avatar, one-liner and links — business-card style

note.zh: 内容以作品网格为主视觉
note.en: A work grid carries the page

note.zh: 身份的第一眼，头像与封面比例固定避免跳动。
note.en: First impression of identity; fixed cover and avatar ratios to avoid shift.

note.zh: 姓名、角色、简介、地点与联系方式。
note.en: Name, role, bio, location and contact.

note.zh: 关注数 / 作品数等关键数字，横向排列。
note.en: Key numbers such as followers or works, laid out horizontally.

note.zh: 作品 / 收藏 / 关于等分区，切换不跳页。
note.en: Works, saves, about — switching without leaving the page.

note.zh: 关注 / 编辑 / 分享等主操作，按权限显隐。
note.en: Follow, edit or share actions shown by permission.

notes.zh: 封面变体：头像用负 margin（translateY 或 -mt）叠在封面下缘，圆环描边避免与封面糊在一起。 统计数字用 flex 分列；页签切换内容流且保留滚动位置。关注按钮三态（未关注/已关注/互关） 与 hover 状态区分；本人视角用 avatar 菜单替换操作区。
notes.en: Cover variant: overlap the avatar on the cover's lower edge with a negative margin and a ring stroke to separate it from the image. Stats split across flex columns; tabs switch streams while preserving scroll. Follow button has three states (follow/following/mutual) with distinct hover; owner view swaps actions for an avatar menu.

basic.zh: 创建一个个人主页，包含头像、简介、统计数字和内容页签。
basic.en: Create a profile page with an avatar, bio, stats and content tabs.

design.zh: 创建社交平台个人主页：顶部渐变封面图，圆形头像带白色描边叠在封面下缘；右侧关注/私信按钮（本人视角则显示编辑资料）；姓名 + 认证徽标 + 一句话简介；关注者/关注/作品数三列统计；下方"动态 / 作品 / 关于"页签切换内容列表。
design.en: Build a social profile page: gradient cover, round avatar with a white ring overlapping the cover edge; follow/message buttons on the right (edit-profile in owner view); name + verified badge + one-line bio; three-column stats (followers / following / works); tabs switching between Posts / Works / About lists.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现个人主页：受控 tab 状态切换内容流；关注按钮三态受控； 头像叠放用 -mt-8 + ring-2 ring-paper；内容流列表数据驱动并支持空态； 移动端统计与按钮换行。深浅色一致；不新增依赖。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind profile page: controlled tab state switching streams; three-state controlled follow button; avatar overlap via -mt-8 + ring-2 ring-paper; data-driven streams with empty states; stats and buttons wrap on mobile. Consistent light/dark; no new dependencies.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现个人主页。

先检查用户数据结构与现有 avatar/tabs 组件，保持一致。
要求：
- 封面 + 叠放头像 + 身份信息 + 统计
- 页签切换内容流（支持空态）
- 关注按钮三态；本人/访客视角区分
- 深浅色一致，响应式
- 不新增依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Implement the profile page in the current project.

Inspect the user data model and existing avatar/tabs components first; stay consistent.
Requirements:
- Cover + overlapping avatar + identity info + stats
- Tabs switch content streams (with empty states)
- Three-state follow button; owner vs visitor views
- Consistent light/dark; responsive
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.
